episodes.title: Jobless Reincarnation
episodes.overview: A 34-year-old unemployed recluse get hit by a truck... and wakes up as a newborn baby in a fantasy world! With loving parents, a lifetime of regrets, and a beginner's magic textbook, he sets out to make the most of his second chance at life.

episodes.title: Teacher
episodes.overview: Rudy begins training with his new magic tutor and learning swordsmanship from his father. He makes rapid progress, but traumatic memories from his past life leave him to afraid to go outside. Is his second chance already doomed to failure?

episodes.title: A Friend
episodes.overview: Rudy begins to explore the village and rescues a green-haired child from a group of bullies. The two grow close practicing magic, but is there more to Rudy's new friend than he thinks?

episodes.title: Emergency Family Meeting
episodes.overview: The Greyrat family is overjoyed when Zenith announces that she's pregnant with a second child, but the mood takes a dour turn when Lilia reveals that she is also pregnant and Paul is the father. Will this be the end of Rudy's happy family?

episodes.title: A Young Lady and Violence
episodes.overview: Rudy arrives in the city of Roa, where he's supposed to spend the next five years tutoring the daughter of the local lord. His student, however, is more than he bargained for, and he'll have to fight to start his first ever job, let alone keep it.

episodes.title: A Day Off in Roa
episodes.overview: Rudy is officially Eris's tutor, but she doesn't want to learn anything but magic. As Rudy struggles to get her interested in other subjects, he realizes that non-stop lessons are causing her stress and proposes a day off in the city.

episodes.title: What Lies Beyond Effort
episodes.overview: Eris's 10th birthday is fast approaching, and her grandfather has invited nobles from across the kingdom to a dance party to celebrate. There's just one problem: Eris can't dance, and she's quickly losing patience with her lessons.

episodes.title: Turning Point 1
episodes.overview: Rudy reaches his 10th birthday, and Eris and her family plan a surprise party for him. Meanwhile, the strange orb hovering over the city remains a mystery as powerful entities across the world begin to take note of it.

episodes.title: A Chance Encounter
episodes.overview: Rudy and Eris find themselves stranded in the wilds of the Demon Continent. Their only chance to survive seems to lie in Ruijerd, a warrior of the infamous Superd tribe of demons, but can he be trusted?

episodes.title: The Value of a Life and the First Job
episodes.overview: Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd make it to a city. They need to earn money for their journey, and decide to register as adventurers, but Superd like Ruijerd aren't allowed inside. Rudeus has a plan, but how well will it hold up in practice?

episodes.title: Children and Warriors
episodes.overview: With their new money-making scheme in place, Dead End head out to track down a mysterious monster. Unfortunately, the job doesn't go as smoothly as they hope, and Rudy's plans may turn out to be a lot less safe than he thought.

episodes.title: The Woman with the Demon Eyes
episodes.overview: Dead End discovers that Ruijerd will have to pay a fortune in fees to leave the Demon Continent. As they struggle to find a way around this unexpected roadblock, Rudeus receives another vision.

episodes.title: Missed Connections
episodes.overview: Roxy arrives on the Demon Continent to begin her search for Paul's missing family. Meanwhile, Rudeus strikes a deal with smugglers to transport Ruijerd across the ocean.

episodes.title: No Such Thing as a Free Lunch
episodes.overview: Rudeus finds himself imprisoned by the beast people in Doldia Village. Will Ruijerd and Eris arrive to clear his name before he loses patience and tries to fight his way to freedom?

episodes.title: Slow Life in the Doldia Village

episodes.title: Family Squabble
episodes.overview: Rudeus and his team arrive in Millishion. In the city, he comes across a kid being kidnapped. He follows them and gets into a fight with the kidnappers, but these people are actually involved with someone whom Rudeus knows very well.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.overview: After having a family squabble with Rudy, Paul kept brooding and drinking. Will Paul's depression and anxieties continue? Or will he have a change of heart and talk to Rudy?

episodes.title: Separate Journeys
episodes.overview: After setting out from Millishion, Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd board a ship back to the Central Continent. Meanwhile, Roxy arrives in Rikarisu, where she encounters some familiar faces.

episodes.title: Route Selection
episodes.overview: Dead End finally arrives in the Shirone Kingdom on the Central Continent. Rudeus is anxious for a reunion with Roxy, but an unexpected vision from the Man-God means he may be in for more than he bargained for.

episodes.title: The Birth of My Little Sister, the Maid
episodes.overview: Rudeus is in desperate straits, imprisoned in a magic-proof dungeon by a despotic prince. But just when all seems hopeless, an unexpected visitor appears with a strange request. Will Rudeus be able to talk his way out of this one?

episodes.title: Turning Point 2
episodes.overview: Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd are nearing the end of their journey, but a chance encounter in a snowy mountain pass threatens to put a premature end to their adventures.

episodes.title: The Forest in the Dead of Night
The Kidnapping and Confinement of Beast Girls
My Dream Home

episodes.overview: Rick seeks a peaceful agreement when rules and morals are tossed aside by new enemies.

episodes.title: What Happened and What's Going On
episodes.overview: After the recent trials the group has faced, a slight detour could be the solution they've been searching for.

episodes.title: Them
episodes.overview: Life on the road has left the group beaten and beleaguered. Will they be able to trudge along? Are they even the same people they once were?

episodes.title: The Distance
episodes.overview: After a spectacular storm, Rick and the group meet a seemingly friendly person.

episodes.title: Remember
episodes.overview: Molding into a new lifestyle is proving difficult for the group. Has life on the road proven too treacherous to go back to who they once were?

episodes.title: Forget
episodes.overview: Rick and the group continue to acclimate to their new surroundings. Will they be able to go back to normalcy? Better yet, what is normal now?

episodes.title: Spend
episodes.overview: While trying to secure their new home, Rick and his group face many challenges, some life threatening. Is this really the utopia it seems to be?

episodes.title: Try
episodes.overview: The group realizes that sheltered life might not be possible as life within the walls starts to mimic life outside. Will these setbacks break Rick?

episodes.title: Conquer
episodes.overview: Daryl experiences trouble on a run while Rick and his group continue to feel like outsiders in Alexandria, where trouble is creeping into the gates.

episodes.title: First Time Again
episodes.overview: Rick and the others have a difficult time assimilating into Alexandria; a new threat arises that could bring the group closer together.

episodes.title: JSS
episodes.overview: When it appears that things are starting to normalize in the settlement, a new problem arises for the Alexandrians.

episodes.title: Thank You
episodes.overview: Rick and his group get caught up in a dangerous little town on the road back to Alexandria. Meanwhile, Daryl, Sasha and Abraham continue to lead away the remaining walkers away from the safe-zone.

episodes.title: Here's Not Here
episodes.overview: A new face appears; trust issues form.

episodes.title: Now
episodes.overview: Following a number of setbacks, the mood in Alexandria grows grim for the sheltered citizens.

episodes.title: Always Accountable
episodes.overview: Daryl, Abraham and Sasha encounter many obstacles and a new threat while trying to return to Alexandria.

episodes.title: Heads Up
episodes.overview: Alexandria is finally able to begin pulling itself back together; peace is embraced between the two groups.

episodes.title: Start to Finish
episodes.overview: After having a few moments of peace, trouble finds its way to Alexandria yet again. Only this time, the threat might be too big to defeat.

episodes.title: No Way Out
episodes.overview: With walkers inside the gates of Alexandria, Rick and the group are scared, outnumbered and things are only getting worse.

episodes.title: The Next World
episodes.overview: A simple scavenging run proves to be more tricky, when the survivors are not the only ones after a goldmine of supplies.

episodes.title: Knots Untie
episodes.overview: After Rick comes to the realization that Alexandria might not be as safe as he thought, decisions must be made about where to go from here.

episodes.title: Not Tomorrow Yet
episodes.overview: Rick and the group realize the only way to maintain the peace of Alexandria is to fight a new enemy. This time, though, our group might be outmatched.

episodes.title: The Same Boat
episodes.overview: With no hope of safety in Alexandria, Rick and his band of survivors soon discover a larger world with new dangers and new opportunities.

episodes.title: Twice as Far
episodes.overview: Two separate groups leave Alexandria for supplies, and while both worry over the future of the community, they will face immediate danger.

episodes.title: East
episodes.overview: When someone goes missing in Alexandria, the community goes on alert, and search parties venture out.

episodes.title: Last Day on Earth
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of a tragic blow, Eugene falls captured by Dwight, a member of the Saviors, whom are hell bent on getting even with Alexandria, Negan teaches Rick and co a brutal lesson, which shows that Rick and co finally have something to fear.

episodes.title: The Day Will Come When You Won't Be
episodes.overview: Last season ended with Rick and our group kneeling helplessly before Negan and his group; what Negan does will haunt those who survive forever.

episodes.title: The Well
episodes.overview: For a number of familiar faces, a new, well-established community seems too good to be true.

episodes.title: The Cell
episodes.overview: A new group of survivors seem to have it all in their impressive community; however, there is a price.

episodes.title: Service
episodes.overview: The remaining members of the group try to keep it together in Alexandria; they receive a sobering visit.

episodes.title: Go Getters
episodes.overview: Saddled with grief and surrounded by enemies, members of the group try to find safety at the Hilltop before it's too late.

episodes.title: Swear
episodes.overview: Someone stumbles upon a brand new society, and this society is unlike anything seen before.

episodes.title: Sing Me a Song
episodes.overview: A deeper look at the Sanctuary and the world of the Saviors; members of Alexandria look for supplies.

episodes.title: Hearts Still Beating
episodes.overview: Negan's unwelcome visit to Alexandria continues as other members scavenge for supplies; things quickly spin out of control.

episodes.title: Rock in the Road
episodes.overview: Rick is introduced to a new community.

episodes.title: New Best Friends
episodes.overview: While searching for a missing Alexandrian, Rick and his group encounter a mysterious collective, its inhabitants unlike any they have come across.

episodes.title: Hostiles and Calamities
episodes.overview: An Alexandrian discovers they must navigate the mysterious, confusing and terrifying world within the Saviors' compound.

episodes.title: Say Yes
episodes.overview: The group scavenges for supplies; back in Alexandria, someone must make a morally challenging decision.

episodes.title: Bury Me Here
episodes.overview: Things do not go as planned when a group of Kingdommers delivers goods to the Saviors during a routine supply drop-off.

episodes.title: The Other Side
episodes.overview: The Saviors visit the Hilltop unexpectedly, surprising everyone, with plans of taking more than supplies.

episodes.title: Something They Need
episodes.overview: A group of Alexandrians embarks on a journey; one member of the group must make a heartbreaking decision.

episodes.title: The First Day of the Rest of Your Life
episodes.overview: The stakes continue to grow higher as paths cross; the group enacts an intricate plan.

episodes.title: Mercy
episodes.overview: Rick and his group, along with the Kingdom and Hilltop, have banded together to bring the fight to Negan and the Saviors.

episodes.title: The Damned
episodes.overview: The plan involving Alexandrians, Kingdommers and Hilltoppers unfolds; as Rick continues to fight, he encounters a familiar face.

episodes.title: Monsters
episodes.overview: Conflict with the Saviors leads to unintended consequences for the Hilltop, the Kingdom, and Alexandria; morality proves tricky in wartime.

episodes.title: Some Guy
episodes.overview: A new weapon in the Savior arsenal proves to be a giant hurdle as fighting continues between Rick's forces and those of the Saviors.

episodes.title: The Big Scary U
episodes.overview: A close look at Negan and the lives of the Saviors during the conflict through a familiar set of eyes.

episodes.title: The King, the Widow, and Rick
episodes.overview: With things looking up for Rick and the group, an argument breaks out at the Hilltop; the consequences of the decision are life versus death.

episodes.title: Time for After
episodes.overview: Negan has to enlist the help of his lieutenants in solving a huge issue facing the Sanctuary; Rick and the group continue to enact the plan.

episodes.title: How It's Gotta Be
episodes.overview: Every story and battle from the first half of the season comes crashing together in this action-packed, emotional mid-season finale.

episodes.title: Honor
episodes.overview: Rick faces new difficulties after a battle. Meanwhile, the fight continues in other communities as core members face hard decisions.

episodes.title: The Lost and the Plunderers
episodes.overview: Groups unite their forces and converge on the Hilltop; Aaron and Enid search for allies.

episodes.title: Dead or Alive Or
episodes.overview: Daryl finds himself in bad company as his group heads to the Hilltop; Gabriel's faith gets tested.

episodes.title: The Key
episodes.overview: Hilltop's leadership faces a difficult dilemma after the arrival of unexpected visitors; Rick comes face to face with an adversary.

episodes.title: Do Not Send Us Astray
episodes.overview: Trouble arises when unexpected visitors arrive at the Hilltop and the community is thrust into action; heartbreaking discoveries are made.

episodes.title: Still Gotta Mean Something
episodes.overview: A Heaps prisoner makes a discovery; Carol searches for someone in the nearby forest; Rick and Morgan find themselves in the company of strangers.

episodes.title: Worth
episodes.overview: With the threat of the Saviors still looming, Aaron continues searching for allies; Daryl and Rosita take action and confront an old friend.

episodes.title: Wrath
episodes.overview: The communities join forces in the last stand against the Saviors as all-out war unfolds.

episodes.title: A New Beginning
episodes.overview: Rick and his group make a risky run into Washington, D.C. to search for artifacts they will need to build the civilization he and Carl envisioned.

episodes.title: The Bridge
episodes.overview: The communities join forces to restore a bridge that will facilitate communication and trade; someone is gravely injured at the construction site.

episodes.title: Warning Signs
episodes.overview: Rick's vision for the future is threatened by a mysterious disappearance that divides the work camp where the communities are building a bridge.

episodes.title: The Obliged
episodes.overview: Rick's vision of a civilized future is threatened by a sudden reckoning with past sins that remain unavenged and unforgiven.

episodes.title: What Comes After
episodes.overview: Rick is forced to face the past as he struggles to maintain the safety of the communities and protect the future he and Carl envisioned.

episodes.title: Who Are You Now?
episodes.overview: The Survivors encounter unfamiliar faces outside the safety of their community's walls and must decide whether or not this new group can be trusted.

episodes.title: Stradivarius
episodes.overview: Carol seeks out an old friend living alone in a wilderness teeming with walkers; survivors make the perilous trek to a new home.

episodes.title: Evolution
episodes.overview: A small rescue mission braves a dangerous herd in their hunt for a missing comrade, only to discover a surprising threat that could doom them all.

episodes.title: Adaptation
episodes.overview: The communities thought they could build a better future separately, but the recent loss of one of their own drives them to band together; new leaders rise when a disturbing and dangerous threat is unmasked; an escaped captive revisits his past.

episodes.title: Omega
episodes.overview: Daryl learns more about the masked tribe's leader; a search begins for two missing friends.

episodes.title: Bounty
episodes.overview: The savage group led by Alpha confronts the Hilltop in a harrowing attempt to retrieve her daughter. A supply run for the Kingdom turns into a dangerous quest.

episodes.title: Guardians
episodes.overview: While one community struggles to ease tensions that threaten to divide from within, the true nature of another group comes into focus; a mission to rescue a friend has deadly consequences.

episodes.title: Chokepoint
episodes.overview: Daryl's daring rescue mission forces Alpha to unleash a group of her own to retrieve what belongs to her, even if the price is paid in blood; the Kingdom's plans to reunite the communities are put in jeopardy.

episodes.title: Scars
episodes.overview: An outsider's arrival forces Alexandria to rehash devastating old wounds; eye-opening secrets from the past are revealed.

episodes.title: The Calm Before
episodes.overview: The fair at the Kingdom is underway, with all four communities coming together in celebration for the first time in years; while some pacts are renewed, other deals will come at a much steeper price.

episodes.title: The Storm
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of an overwhelming loss, the communities must brave a ferocious blizzard; as one group deals with an enemy from within, another is forced to make a life or death decision.

episodes.title: Lines We Cross
episodes.overview: The Oceanside group continues to train in case the Whisperers return. Tensions are high as our heroes struggle to hold onto their concept of civilization.

episodes.title: We Are the End of the World
episodes.overview: The origins of Alpha and Beta are revealed in a flashback; Alpha tries to help Lydia prepare for their journey with the dead; the Whisperers create herds.

episodes.title: Ghosts
episodes.overview: Alexandria is overcome with paranoia as the threat of the Whisperers looms; Carol struggles over her desperate urge for revenge.

episodes.title: Silence the Whisperers
episodes.overview: Negan feels the brunt of the Alexandrians' fears as their paranoia of the Whisperers grows; a safety issue catches the group off guard at Hilltop.

episodes.title: What It Always Is
episodes.overview: Supplies go missing from Hilltop; Negan is idolized by an Alexandrian; Ezekiel holds a secret.

episodes.title: Bonds
episodes.overview: Carol teams up with Daryl as they embark on a mission together; Siddiq finds it harder than expected to unravel a mystery.

episodes.title: Open Your Eyes
episodes.overview: Daryl becomes uncomfortable when Carol starts going past his boundaries; Alpha and Beta share reservations about a certain individual.

episodes.title: The World Before
episodes.overview: A fight causes tensions in Oceanside while the Alexandrians set out on a high-stakes mission.

episodes.title: Squeeze
episodes.overview: The group must figure out how to get out of a precarious situation.

episodes.title: Stalker
episodes.overview: The group must defend Alexandria from a threatening outside force.

episodes.title: Morning Star
episodes.overview: The Whisperers are coming for Hilltop. After Daryl and Lydia's encounter with Alpha, the communities must decide whether to run or fight. Meanwhile, Eugene's communication with Stephanie gets complicated.

episodes.title: Walk with Us
episodes.overview: Negan helps the Whisperers and Alpha launch an attack against the Hilltop.

episodes.title: What We Become
episodes.overview: Michonne takes Virgil back to his island to find his family; in exchange, Virgil offers weapons.

episodes.title: Look at the Flowers
episodes.overview: Everyone reckons with the aftermath of the Hilltop fire; Eugene leads a trip to meet Stephanie.

episodes.title: The Tower
episodes.overview: The communities prepare to participate in the Whisperer War's last battle; Eugene's group comes face-to-face with Princess.

episodes.title: A Certain Doom
episodes.overview: Beta engages the final battle of the Whisperer War.

episodes.title: Home Sweet Home
episodes.overview: Maggie has returned with a story she is not ready to share, even when her past catches up to her. Negan's safety is at stake again. Daryl and Maggie fight an unseen and unknown threat.

episodes.title: Find Me
episodes.overview: An adventure for Daryl and Carol turns sideways when they come across an old cabin. It takes Daryl back to the years when he left the group after Rick disappeared as he relives a time that only the apocalypse could manifest.

episodes.title: One More
episodes.overview: Gabriel and Aaron search for food and supplies to bring back to Alexandria. Small tragedies lead to bigger tragedies as faith is broken and optimism is fragmented when they are put to the ultimate test.

episodes.title: Splinter
episodes.overview: Eugene, Ezekiel, Yumiko, and Princess are captured and separated. Princess struggles with memories of her traumatic past and tries to escape one way or another with the help of Ezekiel.

episodes.title: Diverged
episodes.overview: Daryl and Carol come to a fork in the road and head their separate ways. Each going into their own type of survival mode, the easiest of challenges become much harder. Will their individual journeys be the tipping point needed to mend their friendship or is the distance between them permanent?

episodes.title: Here's Negan
episodes.overview: Carol takes Negan on a journey, hoping to minimize the increasing tension. Negan reflects on the events that led him to this point and comes to a conclusion about his future.

episodes.title: Acheron: Part 1
episodes.overview: Returning to Alexandria from a critical food mission, the group realizes it isn't enough. Maggie proposes a new plan, potentially a suicide mission. What choice do they have? They must find more food for all their people in order to survive and efficiently rebuild Alexandria. If they don't, Alexandria falls, taking them down with it. Once on the road, a violent storm erupts forcing them underground into a subway tunnel. As nerves fray and suspicions increase, chaos ensues. The terror is relentless as our people get a glimpse of what Maggie and her group endured prior to returning to Alexandria. Meanwhile, those captured by the strange soldiers are relocated to another undisclosed location.

episodes.title: Acheron: Part 2
episodes.overview: The group discovers a member did not make it to safety inside the subway car. Surrounded by walkers, going back out into the tunnel to search is a guaranteed death wish. All eyes are on Negan as the rule of survival shifts. It is no longer No Man Left Behind. The motto now is We Keep Going. With very little ammo and energy remaining, the group must ready themselves as the walkers have found a way inside the subway train. Meanwhile, Daryl is in his own intense hellish situation trying to find Dog and finding more than he expected; and Yumiko challenges the process at the Commonwealth outpost, which threatens her future and that of Eugene, Ezekiel, and Princess.

episodes.title: Hunted
episodes.overview: Maggie's mission team gets separated and hunted by the Reapers; Carol, Rosita, Magna and Kelly attempt to catch horses for Alexandria; Judith, RJ, Hershel and Gracie cope with their parents going away.

episodes.title: Rendition
episodes.overview: Daryl and Dog get captured by the Reapers; they are taken to the Meridian and reconnect with a familiar figure from their past.

episodes.title: Out of the Ashes
episodes.overview: Alexandrians encounter Hilltop squatters; Eugene's group undergoes orientation at the Commonwealth.

episodes.title: On the Inside
episodes.overview: Connie and Virgil hide in a house; Pope tests Daryl's loyalty; Kelly searches for Connie.

episodes.title: Promises Broken
episodes.overview: Maggie learns a survival tactic from Negan; Eugene's group clears walkers; Daryl hunts with Leah.

episodes.title: For Blood
episodes.overview: The Reapers defend Meridian from a herd; Alexandrians protect themselves from walkers in a storm.

episodes.title: No Other Way
episodes.overview: Daryl, Maggie, Gabriel, Negan and Elijah battle the Reapers for food; Aaron and the Alexandrians must survive a storm.

episodes.title: New Haunts
episodes.overview: The heroes experience Halloween in the Commonwealth; Daryl and Rosita undergo military training led by Mercer; Carol investigates Ezekiel's medical condition.

episodes.title: Rogue Element
episodes.overview: Eugene looks for Stephanie after she mysteriously goes missing; Connie investigates a story on Trooper Davis; Carol helps Hornsby with a labor dispute at a drug farm.

episodes.title: The Lucky Ones
episodes.overview: Governor Pamela Milton tours Alexandria, Oceanside, and Hilltop. Eugene processes Max's story.

episodes.title: Warlords
episodes.overview: Maggie, Lydia and Elijah help a stranger from another community called Riverbend; they run into Aaron, who tells them about a mission he embarked on with Gabriel as emissaries for the Commonwealth.

episodes.title: The Rotten Core
episodes.overview: Maggie, Lydia and Elijah help Aaron and Gabriel on a mission; Daryl and Rosita pull a heist.

episodes.title: Trust
episodes.overview: Hornsby marches Daryl and his troops to confront Maggie at Hilltop; after a harrowing heist, Rosita gets Connie, Kelly, Eugene, and Max to investigate the Miltons; Ezekiel helps hospital patients in need.

episodes.title: Acts of God
episodes.overview: In the very last mid-season finale for The Walking Dead, our heroes are trapped in situations beyond their control. Everyone they've worked so hard to protect is at risk as danger baits them at every turn. All is at stake. Now, they must decide who and what are worth saving. Each decision comes with its own deadly ramifications. Meanwhile, Eugene and Max's relationship deepens, but so does the trouble that is brewing inside the Commonwealth.

episodes.title: Lockdown
episodes.overview: Daryl and Negan rush to the Commonwealth to stop Hornsby from going after their families. Pamela deals with protestors demanding justice for Sebastian's crimes. Mercer needs Rosita's help to fight a swarm.

episodes.title: A New Deal
episodes.overview: Carol makes a deal with Pamela to wipe the slate clean on behalf of her friends. Aaron, Jerry, Lydia and Elijah get on the road to Oceanside to fill them in on a plan. The Commonwealth celebrates Founders Day.

episodes.title: Variant
episodes.overview: Eugene goes on the run, and Mercer is tasked to find him; Aaron's group faces a complication on the road.

episodes.title: What's Been Lost
episodes.overview: Daryl and Carol investigate the whereabouts of their friends after Pamela disappeared them from the Commonwealth. Unfortunately, their only lead is Hornsby. Meanwhile, Pamela asks Yumiko to prosecute Eugene on behalf of the Commonwealth.

episodes.title: Outpost 22
episodes.overview: Separated from their children, Maggie, Gabriel, and Rosita track a military convoy to a mysterious destination. Ezekiel, Kelly, Negan, and Annie find themselves at a work site. Daryl and Carol follow a train that has taken Connie aboard.

episodes.title: Faith
episodes.overview: Ezekiel and Negan team up to lead a clandestine labor revolt against the warden. Aaron, Jerry, Lydia, and Elijah catch up with Luke and Jules fleeing Oceanside. Eugene stands trial with Yumiko as his defense attorney.

episodes.title: Family
episodes.overview: The Alexandrians and the prisoners head back to the Commonwealth to confront Pamela Milton. Meanwhile, a swarm approaches the city.

episodes.title: Rest in Peace
episodes.overview: Daryl and Carol rush Judith to the hospital; Rosita, Eugene, and Gabriel search for Coco; Maggie and Negan take arms against Pamela; the heroes assemble for one last stand.
